relationships.subject: autologous parietal peritoneum graft
relationships.evidence_quote: Histopathological analysis on day 3 showed significantly lower fibroblast infiltration in the autologous peritoneum group (p = 0.040) compared to other groups, suggesting delayed recruitment.

key_findings: VEGF and IL-6 levels did not differ significantly between groups at days 3, 7 and 14
Autologous peritoneum showed delayed day-3 fibroblast recruitment but comparable healing by day 14
